name: rip
description: Zero-build, full-stack language for reactive UI, schemas, ORM, and server logic.

scripts.postinstall: mkdir -p node_modules/.bin && ln -sf ../../bin/rip node_modules/.bin/rip && bun scripts/link-check.mjs --quiet
scripts.test: bun test --parallel --timeout 15000 test/rip.test.js test/lang test/mapping test/ui test/schema test/toolchain
